name: Digitakt II
summary: Experimental OS 1.17 support on Modwerk's Digitakt II base, including the shared sequencer and project hooks. Downloads remain disabled during research.

firmware.flash: Normal OS updates use Elektron Transfer with the owner's own stock OS file. Modwerk's DTII build path is experimental and downloads remain disabled.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose TRIG 4 (OS UPGRADE), then send the owner's stock .syx over MIDI DIN; recovery mode does not use USB.

research.label: elekloader DTII core and OS 1.17 tests
research.note: Experimental OS 1.17 profile, sealed firmware writer and shared-event core. Its DTII tests verify byte-exact stock rebuilding, seal checks and linked builds. Core builds boot in an emulator; this is not Modwerk hardware qualification.

research.label: toonst's Digitakt II perform mods 1.0
research.note: Released core, perform-direct and perform-levels packages for OS 1.17. The author reports individual hardware results, including an earlier perform-direct version; the combined build is not hardware-tested. Modwerk listings remain to be added.

research.label: core-dt2 1.1 source (Elekloader PR #221)
research.note: Adds frame values, key LEDs and project and kit data to core 1.0's events. Modwerk's base uses this reviewed source and adds its own sequencer and project hooks.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils and the pinned Elekloader kit; firmware builds start from the owner's exact OS 1.17 .syx.

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: Digitakt II DDR region 0x47F00000–0x47F40000, shared by core and linked mods.

budgets.name: Core image
budgets.note: Core 1.0 build: 480 bytes .run plus 20 bytes .bss; package link check measures each selected module set.

budgets.name: Fast SRAM for code
budgets.note: SRAM tail 0x8000F100–0x80010000; core copies .fast code here on its first UI tick.

budgets.name: Per-event subscriptions
budgets.note: The Modwerk base allocates four hook entries per shared event collection.
